SELECT CUSTOMER_ID FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(NAME)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{name}))

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.LIST_PRICE AS price, NVL(SUM(I.QUANTITY), 0) AS quantity FROM PRODUCTS P, INVENTORIES I WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = I.PRODUCT_ID(+) GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.LIST_PRICE ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_NAME

SELECT O.ORDER_ID AS orderId, OI.ITEM_ID AS itemId, P.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, OI.QUANTITY AS quantity, OI.UNIT_PRICE AS price, ROUND(OI.QUANTITY * OI.UNIT_PRICE, 2) AS totalPrice FROM ORDERS O, ORDER_ITEMS OI, PRODUCTS P WHERE O.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId} AND O.STATUS = 'PENDING' AND O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID AND OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY O.ORDER_ID, OI.ITEM_ID
